charcoal-stage.$description: Charcoal Stage — Page canvas, primary surface, all dark backgrounds — the base layer every other color sits on

warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Primary text, nav links, heading copy, hairline borders on dark surfaces — never pure white, always slightly buttered

card-edge.$description: Card Edge — Inset 1px card borders, card ambient shadow, subtle separator lines on elevated surfaces

mute-cream.$description: Mute Cream — Secondary body text, subdued descriptions, muted helper copy

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Subdued heading text, list separators, inactive link borders

bronze-veil.$description: Bronze Veil — Badge borders, card hairline accents, low-emphasis outline treatments

signal-teal.$description: Signal Teal — Teal action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

ember-coral.$description: Ember Coral — Red action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

tasa-orbiter.$description: Single typeface across the entire system. Weight 600 for hero and section headlines, weight 500 for subheadings and emphasized body runs, weight 400 for body and metadata. The tight -0.02em tracking on display sizes (54-56px) collapses the headline into a confident slab; the 0.02em loosening on badge/eyebrow text (13-14px) makes labels feel like printed marks.
